title: Home
description: A small-batch coffee roastery in Bristol.
heading: Roasted on Tuesday, in your cup by Friday
lede: We buy three or four coffees at a time, roast them in twelve-kilo batches and sell them until they run out. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

highlights.name: Twelve-kilo batches
highlights.note: Small enough to taste every drum, large enough to keep the cafe supplied.

highlights.name: Dated, not best-before
highlights.note: Every bag carries the day it was roasted. We think that is the only date worth printing.

highlights.name: Returnable tins
highlights.note: Bring the tin back and the next fill is fifty pence cheaper.
